cand.name: Internal Upset (IU) Pipe End
cand.brief_description: Pipe end where the inner bore tapers down (wall thickens inward) over a short transition to match the tool joint root — OD stays at D, ID drops from d to dᵢᵤ with a ~18° internal cone.
